claims: C1 when citations are possible, the assistant should use them to validate provided personal data
C2 the preference applies to data that is provided personal data
C3 the preference applies only when citations are possible

concepts.name: provided_personal_data
concepts.gloss: D is personal data that the assistant provides in response to a request
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of 'provided personal data'; the notion of data being provided is presupposed

concepts.name: citation_available
concepts.gloss: D is data for which a citation is available to validate it
concepts.inference: 'when possible' in the source text means a citation is available for the data

concepts.name: validate_with_citations
concepts.gloss: D is data that is validated by citing a source
concepts.inference: the source text says citations should be used to validate data; this is the act of validating with citations

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule that carries the root level of instruction authority, the highest level in the hierarchy
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text does not define it

asserts.read_back: validating provided personal data % with citations is preferred when citations are available

closure.reason: the clause states a preference for using citations when possible; it does not forbid providing personal data without citations, so silence permits
